faq.q: What categories and units does it cover?
faq.a: Around 20 categories: length, mass, area, volume, temperature, time, speed, pressure, energy, power, force, angle, data storage, data transfer rate, frequency, fuel economy, density, torque, illuminance, and cooking. These include less common units too — nautical mile, light year, carat, tola, bigha, katha, knot, BTU, lux, and more. A search box lets you type a unit name (e.g. bigha, knot, joule) and jump to it across any category.

faq.q: How does it handle temperature and fuel economy, which aren't simple multiplication?
faq.a: Those are special-cased. Temperature uses offset formulas (not ratios) between Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin, and Rankine, and the formula panel shows the exact expression used. Fuel economy treats km/l and l/100km as inverses (100 ÷ value) while mpg (US and UK) use fixed factors. A note reminds you temperature conversions use offsets rather than proportions.

faq.q: Are the Indian land units like bigha exact?
faq.a: No, and the tool says so. Bigha and katha vary by region, so the values shown (bigha ≈ 2529 m², katha ≈ 126.44 m²) are labelled approximate regional averages, with an on-screen note in the area category. Standard units like acre, hectare, and marla are exact. Verify the local figure before any property transaction.

faq.q: Can I control output precision and save conversions?
faq.a: Yes. You can set decimal places (0–15), toggle significant figures, or switch to scientific notation. The 'Convert-All' panel shows your value in every unit of the category at once, and a Quick Reference table lists common equivalents. You can star favourite unit pairs (stored under uc_favs) and the last 10 conversions are kept under uc_recent for one-click reuse.
